headline: French Montana gave fans a tour of the Underwater Suite at Atlantis, The Palm in Dubai and
body: French Montana gave fans a tour of the Underwater Suite at Atlantis, The Palm in Dubai and said his stay costs $50,000 a night The suite has floor-to-ceiling windows looking directly into the resort’s aquarium. Imagine waking up, pulling back the curtains, and seeing fish swimming past your bed If somebody covered the bill for one night, are you taking the underwater suite or a penthouse overlooking Dubai?
